about: Generated by hooks/build-deny.mjs; edit that file. The guard is a net for honest mistakes, not a sandbox: a command built to get past it will. A rule without `tool` applies to shell commands; with `tool` it applies to every tool whose name matches; `path` matches an edited file; `cs` makes it case-sensitive; `fixed` means no exception can lift it.
